style: Photorealistic golden-hour desert landscape, hundreds of pale pitted limestone pillars rising from golden-orange wind-rippled sand under a dramatic sunset sky with orange and purple clouds, long shadows running to the right
continuity: every pillar keeps its shape, texture and place on the ground as the viewpoint advances, and the scene settles into the framing shown in Picture 2 and holds there through the end of the shot.
ambience: a dry desert wind and faint sand hiss

segments.camera: The camera pushes in at slow speed along the open sand between the pillars and rises slightly, travelling from the viewpoint of Picture 1 to the viewpoint of Picture 2.
segments.action: The nearest pillars glide past on both sides with natural parallax while the distant pillars shift only a little. The clouds drift slowly to the right throughout the shot and the long shadows stay fixed on the sand. The pillars themselves stay still.
